_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
The composer is preserved after a rejected chooser, and screen capture is retried in a click turn. The test seeded a conversation at /c/{{SLUG}}. The page fakes the microphone, screen capture and MediaRecorder, and window.__recordingMock counts what the page asked for (read it with eval, e.g. "window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts"): displayRequests (screen captures requested), synchronousDisplayRequests (those requested inside a click or keydown handler), microphoneRequests, audioSources, recorderStarts, recorderStops and stoppedTracks (media tracks stopped). "The recording state" is the data-state attribute of ".recording-status". Setting window.__recordingMock.displayError to a message makes screen capture fail with it; "" makes it succeed. The recording shortcuts are press_key "M" on whatever has focus, with modifiers "Control+Shift" for "the record-audio shortcut" and "Control+Alt+Shift" for "the record-screen shortcut". Press them on whatever has focus: do not click or focus anything for them. The message input is [data-testid="message-input"], the voice button [data-testid="voice-button"], the recording panel [data-testid="recording-panel"], and its stop, cancel and retry buttons [data-testid="recording-stop-button"], [data-testid="recording-cancel-button"] and [data-testid="recording-retry-button"]. When a step says an element should contain or have some text, assert that on that element, not with a page-wide wait_text. Perform the steps in order. Read the counts with eval "(m => ({display: m.displayRequests, synchronousDisplay: m.synchronousDisplayRequests, microphone: m.microphoneRequests, starts: m.recorderStarts}))(window.__recordingMock)".
1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}} and wait up to 30s for the message input to be visible. Fill it with "Keep this draft through screen failures.".
2. Eval "window.__recordingMock.displayError = 'Screen sharing was cancelled'".
3. Press the record-screen shortcut.
4. [data-testid="recording-error"] should have the text exactly "Screen sharing was cancelled", the recording panel should have data-mode "screen", and [data-testid="recording-preserved-text"] should have the text exactly "Keep this draft through screen failures.".
5. The counts must be exactly {"display":1,"synchronousDisplay":1,"microphone":0,"starts":0}.
6. Eval "window.__recordingMock.displayError = ''".
7. Click the retry button. [data-testid="recording-status"] should have the text exactly "Recording screen + microphone…".
8. The counts must be exactly {"display":2,"synchronousDisplay":2,"microphone":1,"starts":1}.
9. Click the cancel button. The message input should have the value "Keep this draft through screen failures." and be enabled.
